housing.summary: Perth's 1-bedroom apartment in the city centre typically rents for approximately AUD 450–550 per week. Western Australia's Residential Tenancies Act caps the bond at 4 weeks rent. Primary rental portals are realestate.com.au and domain.com.au.

banking.summary: To open a bank account in Australia, new arrivals typically need a valid passport, proof of Australian address, and a Tax File Number (TFN). CommBank allows account opening up to 14 days before arrival. ANZ and NAB also serve new residents.
required_docs: Valid passport (original required for in-branch ID verification within 20 days)

schools.summary: Perth has international schools offering IB and British curricula. The national school directory myschool.edu.au lists all WA schools. WA state schools fall under the Department of Education WA.

legal_admin.summary: Visa holders in Australia must notify the Department of Home Affairs of any address changes. New residents should register with myGov (my.gov.au) to link ATO, Medicare, and Centrelink services.
legal_admin.registration_step: Register with myGov; notify Home Affairs of address changes

tax_finance.summary: All workers and income earners in Australia require a Tax File Number (TFN) from the Australian Taxation Office (ATO). Apply online for free at ato.gov.au.

transport.summary: Perth public transport is operated by Transperth using the SmartRider card. Standard adult fares as of January 2026: 2-section (up to 3.2 km) AUD $2.40 cash / $1.92 SmartRider (20% discount with registered autoload); Go Anywhere (3-hour system-wide) AUD $3.50 cash / $2.80 SmartRider (20% discount); DayRider $7.00. Sundays are free for SmartRider/contactless holders. No monthly pass; DayRider provides unlimited daily travel. Overseas licence holders in WA must convert to a WA driver's licence via the Department of Transport. Medicare registration via Services Australia.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Overseas licence holders must convert to a WA driver's licence via WA Department of Transport. Typically required within 3–6 months of taking up WA residency.
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible visa holders enrol in Medicare at Services Australia offices or online via servicesaustralia.gov.au/medicare.
